The circuit is set up as shown in Fig. 2.1.
P Q
Fig. 2.1
A battery of negligible internal resistance is connected to a resistor of resistance Z. Five resistors,
each of resistance R, are connected in parallel between P and Q.
The switch is closed. The total current I in the circuit is measured using the ammeter.
The experiment is then repeated by changing the number n of resistors, each of resistance R,
connected in parallel between P and Q.
It is suggested that I and n are related by the equation
E = I + Z
where E is the electromotive force (e.m.f.) of the battery.
